output_metadata.query_syntax: IAF Digital Library documented field-query grammar

field_tags.finding: The current wizard exposes exactly the twelve source fields below; the first has an empty HTML name.

wizard_fields.label: year
wizard_fields.meaning: four-digit paper year field; no documented date interval

wizard_fields.label: Paper number
wizard_fields.meaning: source paper-number field and stable route component

wizard_fields.label: language
wizard_fields.meaning: indexed language value; detail pages do not expose it

wizard_fields.label: E-mail
wizard_fields.meaning: source field is exposed; personal values are not collected
wizard_fields.live_contrast: safe nonexistent value only; no privacy-invasive positive

AND.meaning: explicit AND is not documented; a bounded rendered comparison differed from whitespace conjunction, so the typed compiler emits whitespace instead

NOT.meaning: the current rendered contrast did not treat NOT as exclusion; raw input remains caller-owned and no typed NOT operator is exposed

raw_grammar.not_operator: not documented; a rendered NOT-self contrast remained nonzero and is not promoted as exclusion
raw_grammar.stemming: trailing * on a word; documented inside exact phrases
raw_grammar.non_trailing_wildcards: not documented; leading fragments did not match, internal placement produced a source error, and no rewrite is applied
raw_grammar.range_syntax: not documented; year bracket forms are not treated as intervals
raw_grammar.source_echo: current rendered query input, summary, and q route echo the submitted spelling
raw_grammar.adapter_policy: validate bounds/delimiters only; preserve raw syntax

field_tags.live_contrast: each non-email field has a bounded known-item positive or field-specific contrast

boolean_precedence.finding: Whitespace is conjunction, uppercase OR is disjunction, and parentheses group. The known/impossible contrast supports AND-before-OR. In a separate rendered NOT-self contrast, NOT did not exclude the same term; its broader grammar and precedence remain unproved.
boolean_precedence.live_contrast: known OR known AND impossible stayed positive; the parenthesized equivalent was native zero; title:software NOT title:software remained nonzero

wildcards.finding: Official help documents a trailing star replacing a word ending, including inside an exact phrase. In the current rendered title field, software* added one visible plural SOFTWARES record relative to software, and soft* expanded the soft prefix. A leading fragment did not match and internal placement returned the source's 500/server-error page.
not_promoted: *oftware did not match the known software title; the no-star `oftware` control was also native zero
internal soft*ware and software*ing returned a source 500/server-error page
? is not documented; software? matched the exact-term result set while soft?ware was native zero
wildcard-only input is rejected by the adapter
wildcards.live_contrast: title:software* versus title:software; title:*oftware versus title:oftware; title:soft*ware source error
wildcards.error_handling: source 500/server-error pages are failures, never zero-result evidence

variants_and_exactness.finding: No automatic plural or inflection expansion was observed in the tested title field: images matched while image did not, and captured matched while capture did not. The documented trailing star is explicit stemming, not automatic expansion.
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: known title images/captured positive; image/capture native zero

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Unquoted hyphen and space forms were equivalent in the tested title token. Parenthesized quoted phrases accepted both real-time and real time, while phrase order remained significant.
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: title:(real-time) and title:(real time) matched; real time display matched and display real time was native zero

proximity.finding: The official query help documents no proximity operator or distance count. A current rendered exact adjacent phrase and whitespace conjunction were positive, while NEAR/0, NEAR/1, and WITHIN variants were native zero without a syntax-error page. This is bounded no-support evidence, not proof that every undocumented proximity spelling is unavailable; direction and distance counting remain unknown.
proximity.live_contrast: title:("software development") and title:(software development) positive versus title:(software NEAR/0 development) native zero

language_and_document_type.finding: language is a wizard field with free-text-looking values and no controlled selector. event is the conference/event scope and papernumber is the paper identity. The public wizard exposes no document, conference, paper-type, or publication-type field; results are paper records displayed in conference proceedings. About guidance describes papers/articles but publishes no searchable type vocabulary, so no type semantics are inferred from the publication column.
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: English known IAC paper matched language:English while language:French was native zero; the wizard field inventory contained no type control

dates.finding: The only date-like wizard field is year. Current rendered rows for year:2025 and year:2024 all displayed the corresponding four-digit year; year:2024 OR year:2025 formed their exact union, while year:202* broadened to other 202x years. The undocumented year:[2024 TO 2025] form did not equal that union and its bounded rows displayed 2024, so it is not treated as an inclusive interval. No month/day precision, publication timestamp, date basis, or source-side interval control is exposed.
dates.live_contrast: year:2025 and year:2024 exact visible-year positives; year:202* included 2026; explicit OR union differed from year:[2024 TO 2025]

time_zone.finding: The rendered source exposes no publication timestamp or date-time control, and official help gives no time-zone rule. The adapter does not infer one.

contrast_fixtures.name: boolean_precedence
contrast_fixtures.observation: positive result versus native zero; AND binds before OR

contrast_fixtures.name: not_boolean_exclusion
contrast_fixtures.observation: the rendered baseline remained nonzero when NOT was inserted before the same term; NOT was not a Boolean exclusion in this contrast

contrast_fixtures.name: documented_trailing_stemming
contrast_fixtures.observation: the documented trailing star added a visible plural SOFTWARES title to the exact software result set in the bounded rendered snapshot

contrast_fixtures.name: leading_wildcard_fragment
contrast_fixtures.observation: a leading star did not recover the missing initial fragment; both the leading-fragment and no-star fragment were native zero while the complete term was positive

contrast_fixtures.name: automatic_plural_and_inflection
contrast_fixtures.observation: plural title token matched; singular did not

contrast_fixtures.name: hyphen_space_equivalence
contrast_fixtures.observation: hyphen and space phrases matched; reversed order did not

contrast_fixtures.name: exact_phrase_order
contrast_fixtures.observation: quoted phrase order was significant

contrast_fixtures.name: proximity_not_proven
contrast_fixtures.observation: the exact adjacent phrase and whitespace conjunction were positive; the undocumented NEAR/0 contrast was native zero

contrast_fixtures.name: language_field
contrast_fixtures.observation: bounded English item matched; French was native zero

contrast_fixtures.name: year_field
contrast_fixtures.observation: detail year matched exactly; adjacent year was native zero

contrast_fixtures.name: year_interval_boundary
contrast_fixtures.observation: explicit OR returned the union of the two exact years; the undocumented bracket form did not behave as that inclusive interval
